cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: Sets content type based on file content detection without proper validation/sanitization. HTML files with embedded JavaScript will be served with text/html content type, allowing browser execution of malicious scripts.
URL encoding the filename is insufficient for XSS protection when serving HTML content. The browser will still execute JavaScript embedded in HTML files when served with appropriate content type.

Streams file content directly to HTTP response without content validation or sanitization. HTML files containing malicious JavaScript will be served as-is, enabling XSS attacks when accessed by victims.

cwe_content.cwe: CWE-732,Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource

candidate.Reason: Sets content type based on file content detection without proper validation, allowing HTML/JavaScript files to be served with text/html content type which enables XSS execution in browser
Content type detection relies on file content rather than enforcing safe content types for artifacts, allowing malicious HTML/JS files to be served as HTML content
Directly streams file content to HTTP response without content sanitization or validation, allowing execution of malicious scripts in browser context
